Campaign Creator · Screen inventory

The Sponsored Products campaign creator, step by step: ad format, Products, Targeting, Structure, Objectives, Keywords and Review, then creating. The full Amazon flow, then the full Walmart flow. Every frame is the real layout captured at 1440 × 900, with nothing scrolling: long screens are shown at full height and wide tables at full width. Frames are scaled to fit your screen; open this page with ?full for real size (use that for the Figma import).

Pick how shoppers find you for

Auto
Auto campaignThe marketplace picks the searches and pages for you
Close matchShoppers searching terms closely related to your product.
Loose matchShoppers searching terms loosely related to your product.
SubstitutesShoppers viewing detail pages of similar products.
ComplementsShoppers viewing detail pages of complementary products.
Manual
Manual campaignYou pick the searches and product pages
Keyword targetingShow the ad when shoppers search
BroadRelated searches, words in any order
PhraseSearches that contain your phrase
ExactOnly your exact search term
Product targetingShow the ad on product pages
ASIN ExactOnly the product pages you pick
ASIN ExpandedThe pages you pick and ones like them
CategoryEvery product page in a category
Strategy Optional
StrategyWho the Manual campaigns aim at. A tag only; it adds no campaigns.
BrandedDefends your own brand terms. Works best with Exact. Product targets: ASIN Exact (own ASINs).
CompetitorTargets competitor brands and products. Works best with Exact, then Phrase. Product targets: competitor ASINs or categories.
GenericReaches new shoppers with non-brand category terms. Product targets: ASIN Expanded or Category.

ExactOnly your exact search term
